department: Department of Quantum Matter Physics (DQMP), Physics Section

deadline.value: The department page gives no application deadline.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject requirement is stated on the department page.

supervisor.value: The department page does not say whether a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: The department page says it offers several PhD positions each year but does not state that students are funded.

entry_route.value: A Master's degree in physics (Bologna system) or an equivalent university degree is needed, judged by the Section's equivalence commission.
entry_route.quote: To be admitted to the doctoral program of the Physics Section, you must have a Master degree in physics from a university adhering to the European studies system (Bologna system), or hold a university degree deemed equivalent.
